items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ken Kimery is identified in the transcript notes as the 'recording engineer'. The interviewee does not mention Ken Kimery in the spoken transcript, only the interviewer references him.

ctx.x: Interviewee: Eugene Edward ―Snooky‖ Young (February 3, 1919 – May 11, Interviewer: Anthony Brown with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 126 pp.

Today is February 24th, 2009 and we are conducting the Smithsonian National Endowment for the Arts Jazz Oral History interview with Snooky Young in his home in Los Angeles. Snooky Young is known as a trumpeter and he is 90 years young as of February 3rd. Is that your correct birth date Snooky?
